criteria.detail: Verified multi-host PostgreSQL primary R/W + distinct standby streaming replication within lag ceiling.
criteria.criterion: Multi-node PostgreSQL 16+ primary and streaming standby run on distinct hosts/failure domains with primary R/W, standby in recovery, and streaming WAL replay lag <= 16 MiB.
criteria.required_environment_and_permissions: Isolated multi-node staging environment with two distinct PostgreSQL hosts (Primary + Standby), network routing from runner/bastion, read-only monitoring credentials in E4_PG_PRIMARY_DSN and E4_PG_STANDBY_DSN, plus E4_CONFIRM_ISOLATED_STAGING=1.
criteria.expected_result_and_threshold: Primary pg_is_in_recovery()=false, Standby pg_is_in_recovery()=true, resolved Primary IP != Standby IP (non-loopback), streaming_standbys >= 1, max_lag_bytes <= 16777216.
criteria.owner_and_next_action: @rezaa2544 (Infrastructure / Repository Owner) — Provision isolated multi-node PostgreSQL Primary + Standby hosts and inject E4_PG_PRIMARY_DSN / E4_PG_STANDBY_DSN into staging environment secrets.

criteria.detail: Verified off-site cross-region pgBackRest stanza health, WAL archive continuity, and full backup freshness.
criteria.criterion: pgBackRest repository resides in an off-site/distinct fault region from PostgreSQL primary with stanza status code 0, non-empty WAL archive range, and full backup age <= 86400s.
criteria.required_environment_and_permissions: pgbackrest CLI >= 2.50 on staging bastion/backup host, off-site S3/object-store bucket in distinct region (E4_BACKUP_REPO_REGION != E4_PRIMARY_REGION), and E4_PGBACKREST_STANZA.
criteria.expected_result_and_threshold: E4_PRIMARY_REGION != E4_BACKUP_REPO_REGION, pgbackrest info status.code == 0, >= 1 full backup with age_sec <= 86400, non-empty WAL archive min/max.
criteria.owner_and_next_action: @rezaa2544 (Infrastructure / Repository Owner) — Provision off-site cross-region S3 backup bucket and run scheduled pgBackRest full + WAL archive backup.

criteria.detail: Catalog restored and verified, but the audit_log durability table (WORM — M15-05 scope) is not provisioned: the post-target boundary check is unverifiable. Unblocks when M15-05 lands.
criteria.criterion: Isolated host time-target PITR restore from off-site pgBackRest repository matches all 26 schema_migrations checksums and excludes post-target writes.
criteria.required_environment_and_permissions: Dedicated isolated recovery host distinct from Primary and Standby, E4_PITR_RESTORED_DSN, and target timestamp E4_PITR_TARGET_UTC.
criteria.reproducible_command: bash tools/pitr-restore.sh --target "$E4_PITR_TARGET_UTC" && bash tools/pitr-verify.sh --expect-before "$E4_PITR_TARGET_UTC" && E4_CONFIRM_ISOLATED_STAGING=1 node tools/m15-01-e4-verify.js --require-pass --output artifacts/m15-01-e4/e4-probe-report.json
criteria.expected_result_and_threshold: Restored host IP distinct from Primary & Standby (non-loopback), 30 schema_migrations rows with catalog_sha256 == sha256:9acb9da3ea15636d409752c8363bc211a8409d07a553cddff50e8a69c04f1dd5 (re-pinned 2026-11-26 to the 30-migration chain incl. 030_rls; previously 26), post_target_audit_rows == 0 — the audit_log durability table itself is M15-05 scope; until it lands E4-03 reports audit_durability_table_absent explicitly (never a silent skip).
criteria.owner_and_next_action: @rezaa2544 (Infrastructure / Repository Owner) — Execute multi-host PITR restore drill onto isolated staging recovery VM and pass E4_PITR_RESTORED_DSN + E4_PITR_TARGET_UTC.

criteria.detail: Verified multi-host PgBouncer transaction pool routing to writable primary within RTO budget.
criteria.criterion: Real multi-host PgBouncer transaction pooler routes R/W client traffic across primary promotion (`--reroute-pgbouncer-only`) within <= 30000 ms RTO.
criteria.required_environment_and_permissions: PgBouncer instance in staging HA stack with E4_PGBOUNCER_DSN, E4_PGBOUNCER_ADMIN_DSN, and multi-host failover evidence JSON output E4_PGBOUNCER_EVIDENCE_JSON from tools/failover-postgres.sh --live.
criteria.reproducible_command: bash tools/failover-postgres.sh --live && E4_CONFIRM_ISOLATED_STAGING=1 node tools/m15-01-e4-verify.js --require-pass --output artifacts/m15-01-e4/e4-probe-report.json
criteria.expected_result_and_threshold: PgBouncer pool_mode == "transaction", upstream target host non-loopback and unpaused, client query pg_is_in_recovery() == false, 0 < promotion_to_verified_pgbouncer_write_ms <= 30000.
criteria.owner_and_next_action: @rezaa2544 (Infrastructure / Repository Owner) — Run tools/failover-postgres.sh --live against multi-node staging HA PostgreSQL + PgBouncer and record E4_PGBOUNCER_EVIDENCE_JSON.

criteria.detail: Verified >= 3 distinct-host Redis Sentinels in quorum with unanimous writable persistent master.
criteria.criterion: Multi-node Redis Sentinel cluster (>= 3 distinct non-loopback hosts) maintains quorum, agrees on promoted master address, and preserves AOF/RDB persistence.
criteria.required_environment_and_permissions: Three or more Redis Sentinel nodes across distinct hosts (E4_REDIS_SENTINEL_ENDPOINTS), E4_REDIS_MASTER_NAME, and optional E4_REDIS_PASSWORD / E4_SENTINEL_PASSWORD.
criteria.reproducible_command: bash tools/failover-redis.sh && E4_CONFIRM_ISOLATED_STAGING=1 node tools/m15-01-e4-verify.js --require-pass --output artifacts/m15-01-e4/e4-probe-report.json
criteria.expected_result_and_threshold: >= 3 distinct resolved Sentinel host IPs, 100% SENTINEL ckquorum OK, unanimous non-loopback master IP:port with role == "master" and AOF/RDB persistence enabled.
criteria.owner_and_next_action: @rezaa2544 (Infrastructure / Repository Owner) — Deploy 3-node cross-host Redis Sentinel topology in staging and set E4_REDIS_SENTINEL_ENDPOINTS.

criteria.detail: Verified independent-host Prometheus & Alertmanager plane with canonical rules loaded and non-placeholder routing.
criteria.criterion: Observability plane (Prometheus + Alertmanager) runs on an independent host/failure domain separate from DB/pooler hosts with canonical alert rules active and zero placeholder receivers.
criteria.required_environment_and_permissions: Dedicated monitoring host/plane separate from database/app failure domain with E4_PROMETHEUS_URL, E4_ALERTMANAGER_URL, and optional E4_OBSERVABILITY_BEARER_TOKEN.
criteria.expected_result_and_threshold: Non-loopback Prometheus/Alertmanager host IPs disjoint from DB/PgBouncer host IPs, HTTP 200 on /api/v1/rules (>= 11 canonical rules incl. RedisDown & SyncQueueDepth) and /api/v2/status (0 example.invalid receivers).
criteria.owner_and_next_action: @rezaa2544 (Infrastructure / Repository Owner) — Deploy Prometheus + Alertmanager on isolated monitoring host and set E4_PROMETHEUS_URL / E4_ALERTMANAGER_URL.

criteria.detail: E4_ONCALL_INCIDENT_JSON not configured; live human on-call paging/acknowledgement drill has not been executed.
criteria.criterion: Real on-call incident chain (Alert -> Paging -> Human Acknowledgement -> Runbook Execution -> Verified Service Recovery) meets MTTA <= 300000 ms and MTTR <= 900000 ms.
criteria.required_environment_and_permissions: Live external paging/on-call route + human responder drill record written to E4_ONCALL_INCIDENT_JSON.
criteria.expected_result_and_threshold: Non-synthetic paging provider and human responder, valid ISO-8601 timestamps, 0 < mtta_ms <= 300000, mtta_ms <= mttr_ms <= 900000.
criteria.owner_and_next_action: @rezaa2544 + On-Call Responder — Execute live paging/on-call failover acknowledgement drill on isolated staging and supply E4_ONCALL_INCIDENT_JSON.
